visual_format: annotated scene plus paired bars (2 cards)
visual_text: What treatment in the care home included
Illustrative scene based on the trial's pathway
Chest X-ray taken in the home
Close checks by a research nurse
One Canadian trial, 22 nursing homes, 2001 to 2005.
Residents sent to hospital: 10 in 100 with home treatment, 22 in 100 with usual care
Chest infection including pneumonia, 680 residents aged 65 or over
Treated in the home on the pathway
About 8 in 100 on the pathway and 9 in 100 with usual care died. No clear difference in deaths, quality of life or function.
One older trial; close checks by a research nurse
alt_text: Card 1: illustrative care home room. A grey-haired Black man sits propped up in a hospital bed; a nurse kneels beside him holding his hand, a finger oxygen clip on his hand, a portable X-ray stand at the left, tablets, jug and glass on the bedside locker. Five numbered pins match the list of treatment components.
Card 2: bars per 100 residents, Canadian trial of 680 residents. Went to hospital 10 with home treatment versus 22 with usual care; died about 8 versus about 9, no clear difference.
